BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION SP/2023)
CLASS:  BHMCT   SEMESTER : IV
BRANCH: BHMCT   SESSION : SP/2023

SUBJECT: HM212 FOOD AND BEVERAGE SERVICE - IV
TIME: 02 Hours   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 5 questions each of 5 marks and total 25 marks.
2. Attempt all questions.
3. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
4. Tables/Data handbook/Graph paper etc., if applicable, will be supplied to the candidates
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

   CO BL
Q.1(a) Differentiate between ‘American’ and ‘British’ proof system. [2] 2 4
Q.1(b) Briefly explain pot still distillation method with a diagram. [3] 1 2


Q.2(a) What are the characteristics of ethyl alcohol? [2] 1 2
Q.2(b) According to British system the alcoholic strength of ‘XYZ-Vodka’ is 25 degree overproof
and  ‘ABC-whisky  is  25  degree  underproof.  What  will  be  alcoholic  strength  of  above-
mentioned alcoholic beverages in American system?
[3] 2 3


Q.3(a) Differentiate between ‘English’ and ‘Dutch’ gin. [2] 3 4
Q.3(b) Classify ‘Scotch’ based on malting and explain all of them. [3] 3 4,2


Q.4(a) What are the characteristics of ‘Bourbon’ whiskey? [2] 3 2
Q.4(b) Compare ‘Cognac’ with ‘Armagnac’. [3] 3 4


Q.5(a) What are the base and flavouring agents of ‘Calvados’ & ‘Cointreau’?  [2] 4 2
Q.5(b) Briefly explain infusion method of liqueur manufacturing. [3] 4 2
